headline: MCA reportedly releases Draft CSR Amendment Rules 2026 on CSR-1, impact assessment, Schedule VII
summary_points: MCA has reportedly issued Draft Companies (CSR Policy) Amendment Rules, 2026 for stakeholder comments.
Reported changes touch the CSR-1 form, which registers entities undertaking CSR activities.
Reported changes also cover CSR impact assessment requirements.
Reported changes include Schedule VII, the list of permitted CSR activities; details are not confirmed.
These are draft rules, not final; text, dates and comment deadline are not available in the report.
who_is_affected: Companies covered by Section 135, CSR implementing agencies, and professionals advising on CSR compliance.
action_required: Read the official MCA draft, note the comment deadline, and consider sending feedback before the rules are finalised.

social.linkedin:
MCA has reportedly released Draft CSR Amendment Rules 2026 for public consultation.

As per the TaxGuru report, the draft proposes changes in three areas:

- CSR-1 registration form
- CSR impact assessment
- Schedule VII (permitted CSR activities)

The full text of the draft was not available to us, so the exact provisions, the comment deadline and the proposed effective date are not yet confirmed. Being draft rules, they may change before final notification.

Companies, CSR committees and implementing agencies may wish to review the draft once published on the MCA website and consider submitting comments, especially on practical issues in impact assessment and registration.

We will update this post as official details are confirmed.

Please verify the details with the official MCA source before acting.
